subject: Re: VantaHealth - streaming responses stalling (us-east)
messages:
From: Nina Patel <nina.patel@vantahealth.example>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe@redwoodinference.example>
Cc: VantaHealth Support <support@vantahealth.example>
Date: Wed, Nov 5, 2025 at 18:12 UTC
Subject: Re: VantaHealth - streaming responses stalling (us-east)

Hi Chloe,

We are still seeing the same issue today in us-east: stream starts (TTFT looks normal), then it stops emitting chunks mid-answer. Our client waits ~60s (idle timeout) and then aborts.

Request IDs from the last hour:
- req_8f3c2a9b
- req_1a77d4c0
- req_5c9b0e12

We have Accept-Encoding: gzip on (Node fetch default).

-Nina

---
From: Chloe Martin <chloe@redwoodinference.example>
To: Nina Patel <nina.patel@vantahealth.example>
Date: Wed, Nov 5, 2025 at 18:23 UTC
Subject: Re: VantaHealth - streaming responses stalling (us-east)

Thanks Nina — super helpful. We suspect buffering on the streaming route when gzip is enabled. We’re pushing a gateway config change now in us-east.

I’ll update you as soon as it’s rolled out.

Chloe Martin
Customer Support
Redwood Inference

---
From: Avery Johnson <avery@redwoodinference.example>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe@redwoodinference.example>
Cc: Nina Patel <nina.patel@vantahealth.example>
Date: Wed, Nov 5, 2025 at 20:51 UTC
Subject: Re: VantaHealth - streaming responses stalling (us-east)

We deployed the nginx change (force no proxy buffering on SSE regardless of gzip). If you can have them retry now, we should see stable streaming.

-Avery

---
From: Chloe Martin <chloe@redwoodinference.example>

Hi Nina — we’ve rolled out a fix in us-east. Can you please retry and confirm whether the mid-stream stalls stop?

From: Nina Patel <nina.patel@vantahealth.example>
